_comment: Offline process knowledge. Keys are lower-case exe names. category: game|launcher|browser|voice|system|background. safe: yes|caution|no. Original descriptions written for OTX.GNG.

registry.name: Registry
registry.desc: Holds the Windows registry in memory. Protected.

memory compression.name: Memory Compression
memory compression.desc: Compressed memory store that lets Windows keep more in RAM. Protected.

csrss.exe.name: Client Server Runtime
csrss.exe.desc: Core Windows process. Ending it crashes Windows. Protected.

wininit.exe.name: Windows Start-Up
wininit.exe.desc: Starts core services at boot. Protected.

winlogon.exe.name: Windows Logon
winlogon.exe.desc: Handles sign-in and the lock screen. Protected.

services.exe.name: Services and Controller
services.exe.desc: Starts and stops Windows services. Protected.

lsass.exe.name: Local Security Authority
lsass.exe.desc: Handles sign-in and security policy. Protected.

svchost.exe.name: Service Host
svchost.exe.desc: Hosts Windows services (updates, networking, audio and more). Never ended as a whole.

dwm.exe.name: Desktop Window Manager
dwm.exe.desc: Draws every window on screen. Protected.

audiodg.exe.name: Windows Audio Device Graph
audiodg.exe.desc: Audio processing. Protected so game and voice audio keep working.

fontdrvhost.exe.name: Font Driver Host
fontdrvhost.exe.desc: Renders fonts in a sandbox. Protected.

explorer.exe.name: Windows Explorer
explorer.exe.desc: Taskbar, Start menu and File Explorer. Closing it hides the taskbar until it restarts.

searchindexer.exe.name: Windows Search
searchindexer.exe.desc: Indexes files for Start menu search. Can cause disk activity after large file changes.

msmpeng.exe.name: Microsoft Defender Antivirus
msmpeng.exe.desc: Antivirus engine. OTX.GNG never touches it.

wmiprvse.exe.name: WMI Provider Host
wmiprvse.exe.desc: Answers system-information queries from other apps. High CPU usually means another app is querying a lot.

mousocoreworker.exe.name: Windows Update worker
mousocoreworker.exe.desc: Checks for and installs Windows updates. Can be paused during game sessions.

tiworker.exe.name: Windows Modules Installer
tiworker.exe.desc: Installs Windows updates. Interrupting it can damage an update.

radeonsoftware.exe.name: AMD Software
radeonsoftware.exe.desc: AMD Adrenalin app. Can be closed while gaming; the driver keeps working.

vgc.exe.name: Riot Vanguard
vgc.exe.desc: Anti-cheat service. OTX.GNG never touches anti-cheat software.

faceit.exe.name: FACEIT client
faceit.exe.desc: FACEIT client with anti-cheat. Never touched.

otx-core.exe.name: OTX.GNG Core
otx-core.exe.desc: The OTX.GNG service. Stop it from Settings, not here.

otx-gng.exe.name: OTX.GNG
otx-gng.exe.desc: This app. Its window pauses while a game is in the foreground.

otx.gng.exe.name: OTX.GNG
otx.gng.exe.desc: This app. Its window pauses while a game is in the foreground.

msedgewebview2.exe.name: WebView2
msedgewebview2.exe.desc: Draws the window of apps built with web technology (including OTX.GNG). Closing it closes those windows.

chrome.exe.name: Google Chrome
chrome.exe.desc: Web browser. Every tab and extension is a separate process; video tabs use CPU and GPU.

msedge.exe.name: Microsoft Edge
msedge.exe.desc: Web browser. Open tabs, especially video, use CPU, GPU and memory.

discord.exe.name: Discord
discord.exe.desc: Voice and text chat. Keeps full network in Focus mode so voice keeps working.

ms-teams.exe.name: Microsoft Teams
ms-teams.exe.desc: Work chat and meetings. Can be closed while you play.

slack.exe.name: Slack
slack.exe.desc: Work chat. Can be closed while you play.

onedrive.exe.name: OneDrive
onedrive.exe.desc: Cloud file sync. Big uploads can raise ping; it can be paused during games.

obs64.exe.name: OBS Studio
obs64.exe.desc: Recording and streaming. Uses GPU encoders.

code.exe.name: Visual Studio Code
code.exe.desc: Code editor. Save your work before closing.

steam.exe.name: Steam
steam.exe.desc: Game launcher. Needed to start Steam games; downloads can use most of your bandwidth.

riotclientservices.exe.name: Riot Client
riotclientservices.exe.desc: Riot launcher. Needed by Valorant and League of Legends.

battle.net.exe.name: Battle.net
battle.net.exe.desc: Blizzard and Call of Duty launcher.

gamingservices.exe.name: Gaming Services
gamingservices.exe.desc: Needed by Xbox and Microsoft Store games.

valorant-win64-shipping.exe.name: Valorant
valorant-win64-shipping.exe.desc: Game. OTX.GNG only changes its priority through Windows; it never reads or writes game memory.
